name: food-closeup
template: {subject}, steam rising, shot in a home kitchen, shallow depth of field, 50mm

styles.editorial: soft window light from the left, muted colour palette, film grain
styles.menu: bright even light, white plate on dark slate, top-down
styles.documentary: handheld, available light, slight motion blur

negative: plastic texture, oversaturated, text, watermark, extra utensils
notes: Works best with 2-4 word subjects; keep a single hero object in frame.
